description: Pre-distribution gate. Scans all content files referenced in campaign.json for unresolved URL placeholder tokens (e.g., [PART-3-URL], [HUB-URL], [PASTE-LINK-HERE]). BLOCKs distribution if any token is found. A campaign with unresolved tokens will publish broken content.
litmus: Run HOW.py with campaign_file — exit 0=no tokens (safe to distribute), exit 1=BLOCK (tokens found), exit 2=WARN (files missing).

files.HOW.py: Enforcement gate — scan campaign content files for unresolved URL tokens
files.AUDIT.py: Compliance audit — detect past distribution attempts with unresolved tokens
files.WATCH.py: Evolution scanner — signal workflow gap if block rate exceeds 30%

origin_incident: 2026-05-07: Article 03 campaign.json had [PART-3-URL] tokens in hub first-comment and LinkedIn article body. Gate built to prevent distributing campaigns with any such token.
